title: Turnip Stew-Arabic Style
description: Beef and turnips are stewed in a tangy tomato broth and served over rice for an Arabic-style turnip stew.
ingredients: 1 pound beef stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
0.5 (6 ounce) can tomato paste, or more as needed
5 turnips, peeled and cut into 2-inch cubes
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring 6 cups water to a boil in a large pot; cook stew meat in the boiling water until cooked through and water has completely evaporated, 30 to 45 minutes, skimming off any accumulated fat from top as needed.

Stir tomato paste into the cooked stew meat until coated, 1 to 2 minutes. Add 4 cups water, turnips, salt, and black pepper; bring to a boil. Mix lemon juice, maple syrup, and sugar into stew meat mixture; reduce heat to medium and simmer until reduced, 30 to 40 minutes. Serve over cooked rice.
